recommendation: Keep this commit as-is. It preserves the FHIR-47906 boundary content while removing the stale external section link; future broad link-maintenance work can revisit generated-section cross-reference conventions if resource numbering changes again.
issue_request: FHIR-47906 was an Applied/Persuasive R6 OO change request saying the DeviceDefinition Boundaries and Relationships section was incomplete. The accepted motion was to provide more boundary description for medication, substance, biologically derived product, and possibly nutrition, with attention to jurisdictional variation.
initial_application: The requested narrative was applied in HL7/fhir#3838. Commit b14cc796b42d33626adf26a2cacf110ce342f162 added the DeviceDefinition/Device distinction plus jurisdiction-sensitive Medication, Substance, BiologicallyDerivedProduct, and NutritionProduct discussion. Commit 0faeb09d17f8d4bac58d9bba4248fa18533e3ece fixed a missing word, and FHIR-55256 later wordsmithing preserved the same boundary meaning while fixing typos and wording.
additional_context: DeviceDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/devicedefinition/devicedefinition-introduction.xml is the active resource narrative. The current source already contained the requested boundary prose, but the original application kept a copied absolute CI-build link to https://build.fhir.org/devicedefinition.html#8.18.3. The current generated DeviceDefinition page renders References to this Resource as section 11.4.3, making the copied link stale and externally anchored to the wrong section.
reconciliation: Changed only the stale References hyperlink in source/devicedefinition/devicedefinition-introduction.xml from the absolute build.fhir.org #8.18.3 target to the current local devicedefinition.html#11.4.3 target. The accepted boundary prose was left unchanged.
